rule: REFUTED when the median over primitives of changePerMonth (anatomyChangeCount / monthsCovered) exceeds 1 in either series

baseUi.unit: a stable release whose diff against the previous stable release touches the part directory (test, docs and story files excluded)
baseUi.classification: anatomy = exported declarations, rendered tags, data-/aria-/role keys or CSS-variable names of the part differ between the two tags; cosmetic = implementation only

baseNova.unit: a non-merge commit on main that touches the primitive file under apps/v4/registry/bases/base/ui (creation commits are reported, not counted)
baseNova.classification: cosmetic = the file differs from its parent only in class strings (cn/cva/clsx args, className values), comments, formatting or directives; anything else is anatomy
